column1: # `wave`. Originals are kept unchanged alongside this file. 4 ids proposed by two
# slices (ozfish, seamapd21, seatizen-atlas, whoi-plankton) are deduped to one row
# each: ozfish/seamapd21 keep the w2b row (matches the needs:<kind> spec kept at
# the yaml merge); seatizen-atlas/whoi-plankton had identical items/bytes in both
# priority rule: value(1-5, S57 catalog)/stated-or-measured GB for every row
# EXCEPT wave=w1a -- those 6 are pinned above the top of that range (2000-rank)
# because they are labelled benchmark data (COCO/YOLO/VQA, manager directive
# 2026-09-25), which the plain value/GB formula would otherwise rank below small
# unlabelled-pretrain sources; the value/GB priority on every other row already
# ranks labelled/benchmark formats above unlabelled ones at equal size, and
# smaller-GB sources above larger ones at equal value.
# 2026-09-25 and flipped from a false ok/0-items to needs_adapter:<reason>.
